review.scope: v014 plan responsibility, distribution semantics, proof route, and maintainability

source_edits.scope: local config, preflight, tests, Contracts, Inspector, and receipts

report_write.scope: local plan, Contracts, Module Test Cards, governance, evidence, and review receipts

repository_discipline.rationale: Hydra owns task distribution, the existing G1 reset provider owns actuator strength, and the Oracle runtime owns resolved-config admission.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: One Oracle Hydra profile owns the distribution; existing G1 actuator-strength reset code owns sampling/application; Oracle preflight owns fail-closed admission.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The plan reuses G1ActuatorStrengthConfig, resolved Hydra config, typed privileged Kp/Kd scales, and OffPolicyRuntime validation without new surfaces.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Preflight consumes public resolved config only; scripts, environment-private state, and backend-private capabilities remain untouched.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Strength is sampled at the existing reset transaction and sealed by existing config hashes; no new mutable schedule or resume state is introduced.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: One owner YAML and one same-module validator are sufficient; no abstraction, compatibility branch, or duplicate sampler is admitted.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The plan claims distribution and admission correctness only; runtime reachability and learned policy quality remain separate gates.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED tests cover valid composition and one-field invalid distributions; focused owner, config, formal-offline, lint, and Inspector checks form the GREEN route.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Actor remains 98-D; applied strength reaches the existing privileged Kp/Kd scale fields, while the duplicate explicit 29-D strength tail is disabled.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Oracle SAC optimizer ownership and downstream IDM-before-Planner ordering remain unchanged; only the sampling distribution changes.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Existing canonical config hashes make v014 checkpoints incompatible with v013 distribution identity without changing checkpoint schema.

dimensions.name: repository-discipline
dimensions.evidence: Config-first, owner-layer, backend isolation, cold-path asset, and scripts-assembly-only rules are preserved.

residual_risks.description: Offline construction cannot prove the production collector observes the intended reset distribution.
residual_risks.disposition: Require a separate formal runtime audit before training.

residual_risks.description: A learnable-looking distribution does not prove Oracle, IDM, or Planner convergence.
residual_risks.disposition: Require staged policy-quality gates after separately authorized training.
